item.title: Woman Manages To Hide Her Actual Profession For 10 Years, Friend Finally Rats Her Out
item.description: Any form of betrayal can be difficult to recover from. This applies to a cheating spouse or a friend who deceived you through an elaborate lie. A woman experienced the latter with someone she had known from high school. The said friend upheld the lie for an entire decade, making her feel like an utter fool. She now wonders how to approach the conversation.

item.title: 34 Times People’s Intuition Was Screaming At Them To Leave A Situation
item.description: Not everything comes with a neat explanation—but we don’t always need one. Sometimes, listening to your instincts is enough to make the right call, even if you can’t explain it in the moment. Redditors shared chilling stories of the times their gut told them to “leave now,” quickly, and trusting that warning helped them escape genuinely terrifying situations before things got worse. Consider it a reminder to trust your intuition when something feels off.

item.title: “I Tried Living At 4 Houses”: Teen Explains How She Juggles All 7 Of Her Parents
item.description: She has SEVEN parents. Yes, you read that right. While many people are blessed to have two parents, Lily Claire has grown up with more than half a dozen. You'll have to follow the story really closely to properly understand how exactly that came to be. Spoiler alert: she says there's nothing complicated about it and that they're literally one big, happy family.

item.title: 62 Scary Facts That Feel Harmless Until You Think About Them Too Long
item.description: The world is a fascinating, albeit scary place. History has many untold mysteries, and so do our bodies. For example, we just learned that our immune system might attack our eyes if it malfunctions. Also, a lobster diver once survived being swallowed and spit out by a whale. Check out these and more fascinating scary facts in this post, and let us know your favorites.

item.title: “Cancelled His Passport”: 61 Hilarious, Petty And Ridiculous Things People Did After A Breakup
item.description: Some people choose to simply walk away after a break-up, others choose to go to war with a very creative cache of ammunition. From putting an entire bag of sugar in his protein powder before a big bodybuilding competition, to canceling his passport the day before an important flight, here are some of the pettiest ways people have gotten back at an ex.

item.title: In-Laws Say No To Babysitting, Ruin Their Retirement Plan: “Shock From Both Of Them”
item.description: It can be hard to set boundaries with the people closest to you, especially your family. There are often expectations and obligations that parents feel they must fulfil, or that adult children are quietly expected to take on. But when people are too afraid to say no at the right time, there can be conflict and it can even damage relationships. item.description: Person asks the internet, “What’s the creepiest display of intelligence you’ve seen by another human?” and netizens don’t disappoint with their responses.

item.description: If you ever thought you were going bonkers by believing some things existed when, in reality, they didn’t, you might find peace in knowing you’re not alone.

item.description: Someone asked “What's something sneaky you do that you feel no guilt for?” and netizens shared their best, potentially unethical strategies.

item.title: Social Awareness Meter: 29 Questions That Rank Your Personal Wokeness Level
item.description: "Woke" originally meant being alert to racial prejudice and discrimination. However, over the past decade, it has evolved into a much broader awareness of social injustices. In pop culture and social media, being “woke” has been associated with even the smallest things - for example, your milk choice.
